$comment: The essay shelf: the one committed list of which essays are public. Read by client/src/lib/shelf.ts (the site) and scripts/lib/shelf.mjs (sitemap, prerender, llms-full, catalogue). Status live = on the shelf now; pending = being revised, live only once client/public/essays/<slug>.json exists. Any essay not listed here is retired (noindex, out of every listing) unless it was created at or after latestCutoff, which is how new posts from the admin appear on their own. To bring an essay back, add one line here. blurb is the line shown under the title on /writing; omit it to use the essay's own excerpt, or set it to "" for no line.

sections.name: The Mirror: How Sincere Believers Go Wrong
sections.description: How good, sincere Christians in every age missed the sin of their own era, and why we should not assume we are different.

sections.description: Christian nationalism, civil religion, and the capture of the church by politics, measured on the right and the left by the same standard.

sections.name: After Christendom
sections.description: What it means to follow Christ now that Christian America is ending, and what the church learned the last time it lived without power.

sections.name: The American Church: History and Reckoning
sections.description: How American Christianity became American, and the history the church would rather not own.

sections.name: The Ancient Church
sections.description: Christian history in everyday language. The faith is older than the culture that inherited it.

sections.name: Reading the Bible in Its World
sections.description: How to hear Scripture as its first readers heard it, and how the room we read in edits the text.

sections.name: Doubt and Hard Questions
sections.description: Room for the skeptic and the doubting Christian, with the strongest objections stated first.

sections.name: Marriage, Family and Ordinary Faithfulness
sections.description: Marriage, fatherhood, and the ordinary days where faith is actually lived.
